name: Progress Steps
description: Data-driven stepper that shows where a record is in a process (for example an approval or order workflow). One row per step.
helpText: Each query row is one step. Map Status to a column returning complete, current, upcoming or error. Steps are numbered automatically and the current step is announced to screen readers.

attributes.name: Title
attributes.helpText: Step name, for example Manager Approval.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.helpText: Optional secondary text such as a date or the responsible person.

attributes.name: Status
attributes.helpText: One of complete, current, upcoming or error. Unknown values render as upcoming.

attributes.name: Orientation
attributes.helpText: Horizontal steps switch to vertical automatically on narrow screens.
